blob_locator_rule: For every examples path p, blob SHA is the unique blob returned by git_tree(root_tree,p).

examples/README.md.normalized_content: F0_linear is current illustrative material; delay/hidden_state/stochastic/nonstationary are archived legacy families whose old self-certifying JSON artifacts are invalidated. Runnable examples do not establish proof, generality or operability.

examples/F0_linear/README.md.normalized_content: Finite linear example studies future-position target factorization and target-aligned readouts; illustrative finite-menu example only, not the nonlinear canonical F0 ledger result.

examples/F0_linear/system.json.normalized_content: Defines current finite linear example system and admissible parameter/state structure.

examples/F0_linear/system_B.json.normalized_content: Defines second finite linear example system used in partial-interface collision demonstrations.

examples/F0_linear/targets.json.normalized_content: Defines scalar future-position target theta1+2 theta2 and target semantics; target identification is weaker than full parameter identification.

examples/F0_linear/interfaces.json.normalized_content: Defines finite candidate readouts/interventions for illustrative search; menu is not universal interface family.

examples/F0_linear/minimal_interface_sea.normalized_content: Finite menu contains 64 candidates, 26 sufficient and observed minimum cost1 target-aligned readout; frozen enumeration count only, not a general theorem or nonlinear F0 result.

examples/F0_linear/counterexamples.json.normalized_content: Shows partial-readout collisions and target-aligned rank-one sufficiency; explicitly corrects an older false two-readout lower bound.

examples/F0_linear/equivalence_classes.j.normalized_content: Records finite observation equivalence partitions for declared example interfaces.

examples/F0_linear/target_aligned_rank1..normalized_content: Defines rank-one readout aligned with target direction c=(1,2).

examples/F0_linear/target_aligned_rank1_.normalized_content: Reports target-aligned rank-one readout sufficient in finite example; does not imply parameter identification or canonical nonlinear F0 minimality.

examples/F0_linear/traces/*.normalized_content: Finite synthetic trajectories support example-local partitions/collisions only.

examples/delay/README.md.normalized_content: Archived temporal-aliasing design sketch; superseded and not canonical evidence.

examples/hidden_state/README.md.normalized_content: Archived hidden-state design sketch; superseded and not canonical evidence.

examples/nonstationary/README.md.normalized_content: Archived nonstationary-drift design sketch; superseded and not canonical evidence.

examples/stochastic/README.md.normalized_content: Archived stochastic-sampling design sketch; superseded and not canonical evidence.

legacy_json_rule.matching_paths: all *.json under examples/delay, examples/hidden_state, examples/nonstationary, examples/stochastic
legacy_json_rule.normalized_content: Current frozen contents are tombstones with canonical_status=INVALIDATED_LEGACY; validator requires every such JSON to parse, carry that status, and omit old status/interface_boundaries_verified fields. Removed historical self-certifying claims are not current result payload.

legacy_invalidation_reasons.delay: old example used lagged readout inconsistent with fixed deterministic recurrence
legacy_invalidation_reasons.hidden_state: old hidden variable was observationally visible at lag0, breaking intended hidden-state premise
legacy_invalidation_reasons.nonstationary: old theta aliases did not hold over claimed pre-change observations under fixed drift
legacy_invalidation_reasons.stochastic: old shared sequences contradicted different Bernoulli probabilities
